text: きんを　ほって　いるのさ！

structure.en: I'm digging for it, you see!

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. ほって　いる = 'am digging'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ gives what you say as an explanation, here the answer to a question. さ takes the place of だ in a breezy, casual way. ほって　いるのさ = 'I'm digging, you see'.
